rules.policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
rules.source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
rules.source_quote: Patient had failed or incomplete colonoscopy

criteria.description: Diagnostic evaluation of the colon required
Patient had a prior failed or technically incomplete conventional optical colonoscopy

required_documentation: Endoscopy report documenting failure or technical inability to reach the cecum during optical colonoscopy
rules.review_notes: Diagnostic virtual colonoscopy indicated following failed conventional optical endoscopy.

rules.policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
rules.source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
rules.source_quote: As an alternative to colonoscopy in individuals at increased risk for colorectal cancer AND a contraindication to colonoscopy has been provided:

criteria.description: Colorectal cancer screening requested in patient at increased risk
Clinical documentation of medical contraindication to optical colonoscopy (e.g. bleeding disorder, severe cardiopulmonary disease, obstructing lesion)

required_documentation: Gastroenterology or surgical documentation specifying the medical contraindication to optical colonoscopy
rules.review_notes: Screening virtual colonoscopy in high risk patients requiring explicit contraindication to standard optical colonoscopy.
